advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm whether persist_pass_verdicts should also run on a healthy primary SUCCESS (not only the recovery _finalize path); if intended, document why primary-success PASS verdicts are deliberately never cached.
evidence: completion_recovery.py:490-491: '# Primary SUCCESS: the structured output is authoritative; the bank is discarded unread.' followed by 'bank.discard()'
persist_pass_verdicts is invoked only at completion_recovery.py:737 inside _finalize (search_files: single call site in the package)
Primary SUCCESS path (completion_recovery.py:495-498) sets finalizer/certifiable and returns result without any persist call
Ticket 8d74 problem statement: 'no cross-run carryover — every re-verify re-proves all criteria (~10 min/cycle)' — the fix does not cover the primary-success case
advisory.finding: The cross-run PASS cache is written ONLY in the recovery finalize path (persist_pass_verdicts is called solely in _finalize). A healthy primary SUCCESS discards the bank and returns without persisting, so a validated PASS proven by a non-exhausted primary run is never cached; the cache only ever accumulates verdicts from runs that already exhausted into recovery. A ticket that always passes on the primary gets no cross-run carryover, so its next re-verify re-proves every criterion — the very behavior the ticket set out to eliminate.
scenarios: A ticket verifies successfully on the primary run (no exhaustion), then is re-verified after a partial edit: no cached PASS exists, so every criterion is re-proven despite an unchanged scoped fingerprint.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Short-circuit the primary run (return the seeded verdict directly) when all expected criteria are seeded from cache, rather than launching a model run that is instructed to verify nothing.
evidence: completion_recovery.py:532-535: manifest = primary_criteria_manifest(...) then manifest += seeded_context_block([... seeded ...])
completion_banking.py primary_criteria_manifest returns '' when 'listed' is empty (all seeded), so only the seeded directive block remains
No short-circuit returning early when all expected ids are in 'seeded' — the primary step at completion_recovery.py:471-479 launches regardless
advisory.finding: When EVERY criterion is seeded from cache, _primary_manifest_contract still returns a non-empty manifest (the 'already credited — do not re-verify' block) plus the full ordered criterion_ids tuple, and the primary RunnerAgentStep is still launched (completion_recovery.py:471-479) even though it has no criterion to verify. primary_criteria_manifest returns '' in that case but seeded_context_block appends a directive for all criteria, so a full model run is dispatched purely to be told to skip everything.
scenarios: A re-verify where all criteria are still-valid cached PASSes: the primary LLM run is launched with a 'skip everything' directive instead of being bypassed, spending a model call/latency for no verification work.

A record that is merged met=True and bank met=True but bank evidence_sufficient=False (the case that guard exists for) is never tested — the guard could be removed and every test still passes.
